# Memberstack MCP tools

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-tools.mjs from the server's own tool list. Do not edit by hand. -->

The Memberstack MCP server (`https://mcp.memberstack.com/mcp`) has 71 tools. This file is the only place the skill lists them.

- The server sends the full description and argument schema for every tool. Trust those over anything written here.
- "Reads" tools change nothing. "Changes" tools write to the app.
- "Asks first" tools do not run on the first call. See "Confirmations" in `SKILL.md`.

## App and environment (7)

| Tool | Kind | Asks first | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listApps` | Reads |  | Lists all Memberstack apps the dashboard user can access |
| `switchApp` | Changes |  | Sets the active app context for all subsequent MCP operations |
| `createApp` | Changes |  | Creates a new Memberstack application (project) and automatically switches to it |
| `currentApp` | Reads |  | Retrieves the active app context (members, plans, data tables, gated content) |
| `currentUser` | Reads |  | Retrieves the authenticated dashboard user's profile and app access permissions |
| `getMemberstackEnvironment` | Reads |  | Returns the current environment (LIVE or SANDBOX) for member operations |
| `switchMemberstackEnvironment` | Changes |  | Switches environment for member operations only |

## Members (17)

| Tool | Kind | Asks first | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `getMember` | Reads |  | Retrieves one member's full profile by mem_ ID |
| `getMembers` | Reads |  | Lists members (end-users, distinct from dashboard users), newest first |
| `getMembersCount` | Reads |  | Returns the total count of members in the current app and environment |
| `getMemberEvents` | Reads |  | Lists member activity events (logins, signups, plan changes, etc.), newest first |
| `getSentEmails` | Reads |  | Lists the transactional emails Memberstack sent to members, newest first, with each one's delivery status |
| `createMemberEmailPassword` | Changes | For risky changes | Creates a real member with email and password in this session's environment (SANDBOX or LIVE), and sends the app's verification and welcome emails if they are turned on |
| `updateMember` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) | For risky changes | Updates member profile details and settings |
| `updateMemberAuth` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) |  | Updates member authentication credentials (email, password, social providers) |
| `updateMemberNote` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) |  | Creates or updates internal admin notes for a member |
| `deleteMember` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) | Always | Permanently deletes a member and all associated Memberstack data |
| `generateMemberPassword` | Changes |  | Generates a new temporary password for a member |
| `addFreePlan` | Changes | For risky changes | Gives one member a free plan (paid plans are refused) |
| `removeFreePlan` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) | Always | Removes a free plan from one member |
| `removeOneTimePlan` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) | Always | Removes a one-time purchase plan from one member |
| `createStripeCustomer` | Changes |  | Creates a Stripe customer record for a member if one doesn't exist |
| `importMembers` | Changes |  | Bulk imports multiple members via background job processing |
| `exportMembers` | Changes |  | Emails a member CSV export |

## Plans and prices (9)

| Tool | Kind | Asks first | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `getPlans` | Reads |  | Lists the app's plans (membership tiers) with their status, prices, permissions, redirects and team settings |
| `getPlan` | Reads |  | Retrieves detailed configuration for a specific subscription plan by ID |
| `createPlan` | Changes |  | Creates a FREE plan (membership tier) |
| `updatePlan` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) | For risky changes | Changes a plan's settings |
| `deletePlan` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) | Always | Deletes a subscription plan after safety validation |
| `updatePlanLogic` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) |  | Configures automation rules for plan additions, removals, and transitions |
| `createPrice` | Changes |  | Creates a paid price point for a plan and syncs with Stripe |
| `updatePrice` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) |  | Updates an existing price configuration and syncs with Stripe |
| `importStripeProduct` | Changes |  | Imports an existing Stripe product as a Memberstack plan with automatic sync |

## Gated content (15)

| Tool | Kind | Asks first | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `getContentGroups` | Reads |  | Lists all gated content groups (restricted URL groups) in the current app — for auditing content protection, understanding plan-to-URL access mappings, or troubleshooting member access |
| `getContentGroup` | Reads |  | Retrieves the full configuration for one gated content group by ID — all restricted URLs in the group, linked plans that grant access, hosted content blocks (HTML, LINK or FILE, each loaded on the site by its key with data-ms-secure-html, data-ms-secure-link or data-ms-secure-file |
| `createRestrictedUrlGroup` | Changes |  | Creates a new gated content group with URLs and access rules |
| `updateRestrictedUrlGroup` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) | For risky changes | Overwrites a gated content group's name, key, redirect and allowAllMembers |
| `deleteRestrictedUrlGroup` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) | Always | Deletes a gated content group and all its relationships |
| `createRestrictedUrl` | Changes |  | Creates a new gated URL entry for linking to content groups |
| `updateRestrictedUrl` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) |  | Updates URL path or filter behavior for a gated page |
| `deleteRestrictedUrl` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) | Always | Removes a gated URL from all content groups and access control |
| `linkRestrictedUrlsToRestrictedUrlGroup` | Changes |  | Attaches existing gated URLs to a content group |
| `detachRestrictedUrlsFromRestrictedUrlGroup` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) | Always | Removes URLs from a content group while preserving URL definitions |
| `linkPlansToRestrictedUrlGroup` | Changes |  | Grants plan-based access to a content group by linking plans |
| `detachPlansFromRestrictedUrlGroup` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) | Always | Revokes plan access from a content group |
| `createCustomContent` | Changes |  | Adds a custom content block to a gated content group |
| `updateCustomContent` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) |  | Updates name, type, or payload of a custom content block |
| `deleteCustomContent` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) | Always | Permanently removes a custom content block from a content group |

| Tool | Kind | Asks first | What it does |

| `getDataTables` | Reads |  | Lists every Data Table in the current app |

| `deleteDataTableField` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) | Always | Permanently removes a field and ALL its data values from a Data Table |
| `getDataRecords` | Reads |  | Lists Data Records from a table with filtering and pagination — for searching records, directories, catalogs, or querying custom data by criteria |
| `getDataRecord` | Reads |  | Retrieves a single Data Record with all field values fully resolved |
| `createDataRecord` | Changes |  | Creates a new record (row) in a Data Table |

| `deleteDataRecord` | Changes (can overwrite or remove) | Always | Permanently deletes a single Data Record and all its field values |
